data.gender_notes: Qadira is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qadira means 'powerful' or 'capable' in Arabic. It signifies strength and ability. The name Qadira carries the meaning “Powerful, Capable” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qadira usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, capable and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Qadira belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Capable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qadira total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
